calendar.repeatsHint: For August and other seasonal breaks. Not for moveable feasts like Easter, which change date.
calendar.seasonHint: Builds the classes from {from} to {to}, closing automatically on national holidays. Safe to run as often as you like: nothing is duplicated.
calendar.subtitle: Classes day by day, holidays and closures included.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.closuresReadOnly: Only the owner and administrators can create closures.
calendar.rangeStartHint: Click the first day of the closure.
calendar.rangeEndHint: Click the last day. The days between are marked.
calendar.closureEffect: Classes on these days are cancelled, with no charge and no make-up credit. The pool was closed — nobody was absent.
calendar.impactMarked: Careful: {marked, plural, one {# of these classes already has attendance marked} other {# of these classes already have attendance marked}}, out of {sessions}.
calendar.closureOverlap: A closure already covers these days: {existing}.
calendar.gridHint: Click a day to start a closure. Holidays are shown in grey.
calendar.rangeHeldHint: These days are selected. Fill in the reason below, or click any day to start again.
